items.title: S&P 8,500 melt-up? Why money is leaving big tech
items.summary: Trader Talk host Kenny Polcari, Robinhood CIO Stephanie Guild, and Payne Capital Management President Ryan Payne break down the market's massive rotation out of big tech, the reality of AI infrastructure spending, and the bold case for an S&P 8,500 melt-up by year-end.

items.title: Robinhood Earnings Soar Above Views On Record Trading Volumes
items.summary: Robinhood earnings smashed expectations late Wednesday, with Coinbase earnings due on Thursday, as brokerage industry rivalries intensify.  Coinbase is on deck late Thursday.  Robinhood saw "new highs across equity, option and event contract volumes," CFO Shiv Verma said in an earnings release.

items.title: Robinhood quarterly profit rises on strong trading activity
items.summary: Robinhood Markets posted ‌a rise ‌in second-quarter profit ​on Wednesday, as volatility in the markets ‌spurred higher ⁠trading activity on its ⁠platform. The Menlo Park, California-based ​company's ​profit ​was $573 million, ‌or 62 cents per share, for the three months ended ‌June 30, ​compared ​with $386 ​million, or ‌42 cents per ​share, ​a year earlier.

items.title: SoFi Sinks 10% as Record Q2 Revenue Beat Meets Unchanged Profit Guidance
items.summary: SoFi crushed revenue estimates and raised its top-line outlook, yet shares cratered 10% anyway as sellers zeroed in on one number management refused to budge on.

items.title: XRP vs Solana vs Ethereum: Which Turns $5,000 Into $10,000 by the End of 2027?
items.summary: XRP, Solana, and Ethereum are all trading well below their peaks, and each coin has a specific catalyst that could push it to double a $5,000 investment before 2028. But only one of them has buying that has actually started.

items.title: Is Robinhood Markets (HOOD) a Buy as Wall Street Analysts Look Optimistic?
items.summary: Based on the average brokerage recommendation (ABR), Robinhood Markets (HOOD) should be added to one's portfolio. Wall Street analysts' overly optimistic recommendations cast doubt on the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric. So, is the stock worth buying?

items.title: StoneX's High ROE Supports the Bull Case: Is It Sustainable?
items.summary: SNEX's 19.31% ROE tops its 15% long-term target, but rising costs, credit losses and margin pressure could test whether those returns endure.
